title: Review or apply an exact Megamono adoption policy
description: Report graph findings without enrollment by default. Apply only an explicitly reviewed policy file after complete validation.

apply.description: Apply the reviewed policyFile and opt in to configuration version 2.

dryRun.description: Validate and print the report without writing any files, including --report.

policyFile.description: Workspace-relative reviewed JSON policy: schemaVersion 1, optional boundaryAllowances/warningBaseline, and explicit replaceLegacyRatchets.

report.description: Optional workspace-relative JSON report. Existing unrelated files are never overwritten.
